<!-- EDIT ME: research themes are hand-written; the funded projects list below updates from the CV. -->

**Climate hazards and health in cities.** Heat, cold, floods, and other climate hazards and their effects on
mortality and morbidity across hundreds of Latin American cities and U.S. settings.

**Environmental health inequities.** Who is most exposed and most affected, from neighborhoods to whole
populations, and which features of the urban environment drive those differences.

**Air pollution, indoors and out.** Ambient air pollution in Latin American cities, and household air
pollution and clean-cooking interventions.
